[[File:Thomas Whaley 2007 World Championship interview.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Thomas Whaley at the 2007 World Championship]]
'''Thomas Whaley''' (listed as '''Thomas E. Whaley''' on his 2007 Worlds deck sheets<ref name="w07d2" /><ref name="w07team" />) played the [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]], finishing 9th on Day 1 and taking the 7th Day 2 seat after [[Nick Reisch]] dropped,<ref name="tmw15" /> and the [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]].<ref name="tmw16">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-texas-mini-worlds/ 2016 Texas Mini Worlds], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130753/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]</ref>
